description: This source file contains a PHPUnit test class 'EmployeeSkillDaoTest' that tests the 'EmployeeSkillDao' data access object, which manages employee skills data within the OrangeHRM system. The class includes setup procedures, multiple test cases for CRUD operations, searches, and related data retrieval functionalities related to employee skills.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the 'EmployeeSkillDao' data access object, focusing on employee skill data retrieval, creation, modification, deletion, and filtering functionalities in the OrangeHRM PIM module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeSkillDao instance and populates test data from a YAML fixture before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSkillById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an employee skill by its ID and verifies comments and experience years.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple employee skills by their IDs.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Tests searching employee skills with specific filter parameters.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeSkillWithLimit
methods.description: Tests searching employee skills with a limit on the number of results.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee skill and verifies saved data.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Tests editing an existing employee skill and verifies updated data.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeSkillsCount
methods.description: Tests counting employee skills matching specific search criteria.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedSkills
methods.description: Tests retrieval of skills allowed for a specific employee and compares with overall skills in the system.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedSkillsCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of skills allowed for specific employees.
